tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find US-listed companies covered by EquiReason by ticker or name. Returns ticker, name, sector and the company page.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A company's filed record: annual income, balance-sheet and cash-flow lines from SEC XBRL, revenue mix by reported segment, the latest filings with plain-language summaries and links, Form 4 insider trades (planned vs unplanned), 13F holder counts by quarter, risk-factor changes and earnings-call dat

tools.name: list_filing_events
tools.description: Companies with a given event in the last 7 days (or an earlier ISO week): guidance raised or cut, unplanned insider buying, executive changes, acquisitions, buybacks, layoffs. Each row quotes the filing or call.

tools.name: list_funds
tools.description: The institutional investors EquiReason tracks, with their latest 13F period, position count and reported value.

tools.name: get_fund_holdings
tools.description: A tracked fund's latest 13F: positions with shares and reported value, what changed against the prior quarter, and positions it exited.

tools.name: list_trends
tools.description: The market trends EquiReason is following, with how many companies' filings describe each.

tools.name: get_trend
tools.description: One trend: the industries it supports, its knock-on effects with their expected lag, the evidence count by source type, and the conditions that would end it.

tools.name: get_opportunities
tools.description: Companies ranked by EquiReason's verdict, with band, score, the matched trend and the evidence count — optionally for one trend. Requires signing in; depth follows the plan.

tools.name: get_company_history
tools.description: Read EquiReason's forward-observed revision ledger as of an ISO date or offset timestamp. Coverage starts at the system's first capture for each domain: values before that capture are unknown, not reconstructed, and overwritten pre-ledger intraday data is not recovered. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_history · Private data: get_company · Public sink: get_company_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_history · Private data: get_company · Public sink: get_company_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
